flashcard_questions.q: The profit a business makes after deducting the direct costs of making or buying its products from sales revenue.
The profit remaining after all costs (cost of sales and operating costs) have been deducted from sales revenue.
The percentage of sales revenue that is gross profit, showing how much of every £1 of sales is kept after direct costs.

flashcard_questions.a: The percentage of sales revenue that is net profit, showing how much of every £1 of sales the business actually keeps after all costs.
